data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017, there was an early distribution of the 2015 year of account profit. As a result of adverse development in the year and the early distribution made on the 2015 Year of Account in 2016, there is now the requirement to collect a small amount of pre-distributed profits.

prior_year_events.event_name: Early distribution of the 2015 year of account profit
prior_year_events.impact_description: Early distribution followed by adverse development requiring collection of pre-distributed profits

prior_year_events.event_name: Early profit release on 2016 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Early profit release (post balance event) proposed to transfer to Personal Reserve Fund

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $31.923m. The reported analysis and claims development triangle indicate effectively no material gross prior-year development for underwriting years prior to 2016 (net prior-year movement  $0m). The report does note an early distribution of 2015 year profits and subsequent adverse development that required collection of a small amount of pre-distributed profits, but no explicit gross PYD figure is stated in the accounts.
raw_causal_phrases: requirement to collect a small amount of pre-distributed profits
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was presented. The gross claims development triangle (gross) was used as the primary source and indicates no material movement for underwriting years prior to 2016 (PYD  $0m). The report does reference an early distribution of 2015 profits and subsequent small collect event (post balance) - these distributions/collections are noted but do not provide a clear gross PYD amount. All monetary figures are reported in the native currency (USD).
